sky.note: Source panorama is 4096x4096 equirectangular; resampled to 4096x2048 WebP q88 for the web (6.8 MB -> 0.6 MB).
sky.prompt: 360-degree equirectangular panorama seen from a rooftop high in a dense cyberpunk megacity at night, horizon at eye level. Tall skyscrapers ring the view, covered in magenta and cyan neon signs and huge holographic billboards with Japanese characters. Low cloud ceiling glowing purple, lit from below by the city. Haze, fine rain mist, distant flying-car light trails. Streets far below glowing. Cinematic, moody, wet, Blade Runner atmosphere, no sun, no stars.
